column1: # Glossary entries the OCR could not read, adjudicated against the facsimile of
# leaf 25 at native resolution. The list is set in a swash italic -- the capitals
# are 𝒜 ℳ 𝒩 𝒥 -- which every engine mangles: `MS. y MSS.` comes back as
# `5VCS. y íhCSS.`, `M. M.` as a bare `M.`, `N. C.` as `N. C.` only sometimes.
# Two entries also arrive merged into one line, `J. Anónimo. /. M. — Juan
# Antonio Mateu.`, which is `A.—Anónimo.` and `J. M.—Juan Antonio Mateu.`
